lookback_source.quote: Consider the previous review of the clinical record, staff interviews across all shifts and disciplines, interviews with others who had close interactions with the resident and previous observations of the behaviors identified in E0200 for the 7-day look-back period.

lookback_notes: The item's own Steps for Assessment state a 7-day look-back period for the behaviors identified in E0200 that are evaluated here. Counted per the general convention as ARD plus the 6 previous calendar days (rai-manual-v1.20.1, p. 2-21).

coding_levels.label: E0600A — Code 0, no
coding_levels.definition: None of the identified behavioral symptom(s) placed staff, visitors, or other residents at significant risk for physical injury.

source.quote: Code 0, no: if none of the identified behavioral symptom(s) placed staff, visitors, or other residents at significant risk for physical injury.

coding_levels.label: E0600A — Code 1, yes
coding_levels.definition: Any of the identified behavioral symptom(s) placed staff, visitors, or other residents at significant risk for physical injury.

source.quote: Code 1, yes: if any of the identified behavioral symptom(s) placed staff, visitors, or other residents at significant risk for physical injury.

coding_levels.label: E0600B — Code 0, no
coding_levels.definition: None of the identified behavioral symptom(s) significantly intruded on the privacy or activity of others.

source.quote: Code 0, no: if none of the identified behavioral symptom(s) significantly intruded on the privacy or activity of others.

coding_levels.label: E0600B — Code 1, yes
coding_levels.definition: Any of the identified behavioral symptom(s) kept other residents from enjoying privacy or engaging in informal activities (not organized or run by staff). Includes coming in uninvited, invading, or forcing oneself on others' private activities.

source.quote: Code 1, yes: if any of the identified behavioral symptom(s) kept other residents from enjoying privacy or engaging in informal activities (not organized or run by staff). Includes coming in uninvited, invading, or forcing oneself on others’ private activities.

coding_levels.label: E0600C — Code 0, no
coding_levels.definition: None of the identified behavioral symptom(s) significantly disrupted delivery of care or the living environment.

source.quote: Code 0, no: if none of the identified behavioral symptom(s) significantly disrupted delivery of care or the living environment.

coding_levels.label: E0600C — Code 1, yes
coding_levels.definition: Any of the identified behavioral symptom(s) created a climate of excessive noise or interfered with the receipt of care or participation in organized activities by other residents.

source.quote: Code 1, yes: if any of the identified behavioral symptom(s) created a climate of excessive noise or interfered with the receipt of care or participation in organized activities by other residents.

federal_coding_rules.rule: E0600 is completed only when E0300 is coded 1, yes (any of E0200A, E0200B, or E0200C coded 1, 2, or 3); if E0300 is coded 0, skip to E0800.

source.quote: Code 1, yes: if any of E0200A, E0200B, or E0200C were coded 1, 2, or 3. Proceed to complete Impact on Resident item (E0500), and Impact on Others item (E0600).

federal_coding_rules.rule: To code E0600, determine if the behaviors identified (in E0200) put others at significant risk of physical illness or injury, intruded on their privacy or activities, and/or interfered with their care or living environments.

source.quote: To code E0600, determine if the behaviors identified put others at significant risk of physical illness or injury, intruded on their privacy or activities, and/or interfered with their care or living environments.

federal_coding_rules.rule: For E0600A, code based on whether the behavior placed others at significant risk for physical injury; physical injury is trauma resulting in pain or other distressing physical symptoms, impaired organ function, physical disability or other adverse consequences, regardless of the need for medical, surgical, nursing, or rehabilitative intervention.

source.quote: For E0600A, code based on whether the behavior placed others at significant risk for physical injury. Physical injury is trauma that results in pain or other distressing physical symptoms, impaired organ function, physical disability or other adverse consequences, regardless of the need for medical, surgical, nursing, or rehabilitative intervention.

federal_coding_rules.rule: For E0600B, code based on whether the behavior violates other residents' privacy or interrupts other residents' ADL performance or limits engagement in or enjoyment of informal social or recreational activities to such an extent that it causes the other residents distress or inconvenience — whether or not the other residents complain.

source.quote: For E0600B, code based on whether the behavior violates other residents’ privacy or interrupts other residents’ performance of activities of daily living or limits engagement in or enjoyment of informal social or recreational activities to such an extent that it causes the other residents to experience distress (e.g., displeasure or annoyance) or inconvenience, whether or not the other residents complain.

federal_coding_rules.rule: For E0600C, code based on whether the behavior interferes with staff ability to deliver care or conduct organized activities, interrupts receipt of care or participation in organized activities by other residents, and/or causes other residents to experience distress or adverse consequences.

source.quote: For E0600C, code based on whether the behavior interferes with staff ability to deliver care or conduct organized activities, interrupts receipt of care or participation in organized activities by other residents, and/or causes other residents to experience distress or adverse consequences.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Intrusion on another resident's privacy is coded 1 at E0600B regardless of whether the affected residents complain or communicate distress (example: repeatedly entering others' rooms and rummaging through belongings).

source.quote: Rationale: This is an intrusion and violates other residents’ privacy regardless of whether they complain or communicate their distress.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Resident intent is not taken into account when coding items in Section E; coding focuses on the resident's actions rather than the intent of their behavior.

source.quote: Resident intent should not be taken into account when coding for items in this section.

federal.criterion: Review of the clinical record for the 7-day look-back period, considered together with the prior review performed for the behaviors identified in E0200.

source.quote: Consider the previous review of the clinical record, staff interviews across all shifts and disciplines, interviews with others who had close interactions with the resident and previous observations of the behaviors identified in E0200 for the 7-day look-back period.

federal.notes: Listed as step 1 of Steps for Assessment for E0600.

federal.criterion: Staff interviews across all shifts and disciplines, plus interviews with others who had close interactions with the resident, regarding the behaviors identified in E0200.

source.quote: staff interviews across all shifts and disciplines, interviews with others who had close interactions with the resident and previous observations of the behaviors identified in E0200 for the 7-day look-back period

federal.criterion: Observations of the behaviors identified in E0200 during the 7-day look-back period.

source.quote: previous observations of the behaviors identified in E0200 for the 7-day look-back period

federal.criterion: Documentation supporting comparison of subsequent assessments to a baseline to identify changes in the resident's behavior, including response to interventions.

source.quote: Subsequent assessments and documentation can be compared with a baseline to identify changes in the resident’s behavior, including response to interventions.

federal.notes: Framed as care-planning rationale, not as a coding requirement.
